description: Open Data Armenia is an open data portal listed in Open Data Armenia, an open data portal (CKAN) run by a civil-society initiative, published or maintained by Open Data Armenia (civil-society initiative). Open Data Armenia publishes open datasets. Coverage: Armenia. This harvest read all datasets of the portal through its CKAN API; 37 of them are about infrastructure or natural hazards and became 18 records. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is set per dataset on the portal. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support finding infrastructure and hazard data of this country. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-opendata-am.

discovery_routes.query: CKAN package_search read of all datasets
